11. Period of stay for non-official guests will be for a maximum of 07days and 06 Nights, subject to the availability of rooms.

12. The room tariff does not include any meals, snacks or tea.

13. Faculty/ staff members can book accommodation for their relatives at the specified tariff for a maximum of 12 days in a calendar year.

14. Priority of guests for booking with the recommending and approving authority shall be as under:

| Guest type | Booking Window | Recommendation by | Approval by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Institute Guests | 3 Months | Program/Event Co-coordinator | VC/Director/Registrar/ Dean(s) |
| Personal Guests of Employees | 15 Days | Employee | Oi/c Guest House |
| Parents/Guardians of Students and Alumni | 07 Days | Hostel warden/Faculty in-charge | Oi/c Guest House |
| Government Guests (not on institute events) | 07 Days | Faculty/staff | Oi/c Guest House |
| Other Guests | 02 Days | Faculty/staff | Oi/c Guest House |

15. The requisition form for the Guest house is available on the institute website.

16. The duly filled-in form should be forwarded to the Oi/c Guest house for approval. The confirmation shall be intimated, subject to the availability of rooms during the period of stay.

17. No guest will be allowed without prior approval of the competent authority.

18. The revised tariff of Rooms for different categories of guests is as follows:

| Category C | Parents/Relatives of Students/Alumni | Guest | Rs 900 | Rs 3500 | GST as applicable |
| Category D | Other Guest | Guest | Rs 1500 | Rs 3500 | GST as applicable |

Exception- Notwithstanding anything contained herein, the Vice-Chancellor/Director of the institute shall be empowered to relax the conditions.
